label: Archaludon ex / Cinderace
summary: Slow Metal heal-wall: Duraludon -> Archaludon ex (300 HP, Metal Defender 220, self-negates its own Fire weakness for one turn) armored by Full Metal Lab -30 + Hero's Cape +100 + Jumbo Ice Cream heal 80, ramped by a setup-only Cinderace. Chip is worthless; beat it by out-tempoing the turns-1-2 window and bursting through Fire weakness in a Metal-Defender-OFF window (a benched/idle/just-evolved Archaludon has live x2).

threats.why: The wall + payoff: 300 HP Stage 1 (2 prizes), Metal Defender (MMM) 220 that OHKOs most 200-220-HP attackers and self-negates its Fire weakness on your next turn. Near-unkillable under Full Metal Lab (-30) + Hero's Cape (+100) + Jumbo Ice Cream (heal 80).
Cheap {C} 50 attacker AND the turn-1 Metal accelerator (Turbo Flare searches up to 3 basic energy to the bench); it arms the wall. Retreat 0, pivots freely.
Raging Hammer (80 + 10 per damage counter on itself) scales as it is chipped; via Relicanth's Memory Dive, Archaludon ex can borrow it too. Do not leave a battered body alive.

targets.why: 130 HP Basic, Fire x2, 1 prize; the wall before it evolves. KO/gust it Active on turns 1-2 (a Fire ~80 base OHKOs) to deny the 2-prize Archaludon ex. Benched snipe is inefficient (bench ignores weakness and Full Metal Lab still applies -30).

PRIMARY: the sole Metal accelerator, enters play only at setup via Explosiveness (no Raboot line), unrecoverable once KO'd. 160 HP, Water x2, 1 prize, retreat 0. KO it early to strip turn-1 ramp; value decays once it has dumped energy and pivoted.

SECONDARY/situational: the lone Memory Dive enabler that lets a chipped Archaludon ex borrow Raging Hammer (up to ~370). 100 HP Fighting Basic, NOT Metal so Full Metal Lab does not shield it; snipe/gust early to cap Archaludon at flat-220 and re-open the chip-then-finish line.

2 prizes, the payoff. Do not grind the 300-400 HP body; Fire-OHKO a freshly-evolved/idle/benched copy whose no-Weakness shield has lapsed (Fire base >=165 bare / >=215 caped under Full Metal Lab), or gust a fresh copy Active before it establishes Metal Defender.
